== Fan projects drive listing ==

A short [[Fan projects]] section was added for the Google Drive folder listed under the name Andyt563 in the 9 January 2021 stickied r/starwarsccgalters post. Andyt563 is the GEMP handle already given in the lead, so the folder is treated as [[Andrew Thomas]]'s.

Post: [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccgalters/comments/ku0xau/mpc_print_ready_cards_links_to_drives_and/ MPC Print Ready Cards - Links to drives and community disclaimer], r/starwarsccgalters, 9 January 2021.
